definitions.explanation: A strip of cloth tied around the head. Worn as a symbol of effort, determination, or team spirit during festivals, sports events, studying, and manual labor.

examples.japanese: {鉢巻|はちまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧。
⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{鉢巻|はちまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Children wearing red headbands are running at the sports day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{受験|じゅけん}{勉強|べんきょう}→受験勉強：09977_jukenbenkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気合|きあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{鉢巻|はちまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}いて→巻く：02418_maku⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: To fire myself up for exam studying, I tied on a headband and sat down at my desk.

notes:
USAGE:
{鉢巻|はちまき} is deeply associated with determination and effort in Japanese culture. It is worn to show that one is serious and focused.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉢巻|はちまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ (to tie a headband)
- {鉢巻|はちまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wrap/put on a headband)
- {鉢巻|はちまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to take off a headband)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{鉢巻|はちまき} are commonly seen at:
- ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧ (festivals) — worn by participants carrying portable shrines
- ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧ (school sports days) — in team colors
- ⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧ (exam preparation) — as a symbol of dedication
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧ (cheering) — with slogans like {必勝|ひっしょう} (certain victory) written on them
